# Application Security & DevSecOps Course
# https://course.geminishkv.tech
# Author: Elijah S Shmakov (geminishkv) — Application Security Teamlead
# Language: Russian

## About
This is a practical Application Security (AppSec) and DevSecOps course created by Elijah S Shmakov for BMSTU (Bauman Moscow State Technical University) and MIPT (Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology). The course covers the full secure development lifecycle: from Git basics to CI/CD pipeline security.

## Structure
- 7 introductory guides (VirtualBox setup, Git/GPG, Gistup reports, Networking/TCP-IP, Docker basics, CI/CD intro, AppSec tools installation)
- 10 lab works (Git, Linux, Nmap, Risk Analysis, Docker, CIS Benchmark, SAST/SCA/Secret Detection, DAST, DevSecOps CI/CD, Final Risk Analysis)
- 1 pet-project (full AppSec/DevSecOps stack)
- 7 tests (5 basic variants + 2 Fintech lecture variants)
- Reference materials: OWASP Top 10, CheatSheets, examples, lectures

## Topics Covered
- Git, GitHub, GPG signing, SSH keys
- Linux permissions, SUID, SGID, Sticky bit, POSIX ACL
- Network scanning with Nmap, NSE scripts
- Risk analysis methodology (ISO 27005, NIST SP 800-30, OWASP Risk Rating)
- Docker containerization, Dockerfile security, Docker Compose
- CIS Docker Benchmark, Docker Bench Security, Trivy
- SAST: Semgrep, Checkov, Bandit
- SCA: OWASP Dependency-Check
- Secret Detection: Gitleaks, TruffleHog, pre-commit hooks
- DAST: OWASP ZAP (baseline + active scan)
- DevSecOps CI/CD: GitHub Actions pipelines with Quality Gates
- Compliance: GDPR, 152-FZ, 115-FZ (AML), PCI DSS, GOST 57580
